subject: [hw] V17 -> T01: k18_float and k_fminmax both fixed (20/20 seeds in arm-O2, thumb-O2, armv8-O3v)
body:
Both V17-attributed mismatches are fixed in commit 1a4034f.

1. k18_float: root cause was MY VMOV immediate decoder, not VMLA/VCVT. The VFP imm8 format has no zero encoding: imm8=0x00 is +2.0 and 0x80 is -2.0. My code had a bogus "zero form" branch (from an incorrect reading of the immediate pseudocode) that produced +-0.0 for those two encodings; the arm-O2/thumb-O2 code shape uses `vmov.f32 s4,#-1.0` / `#-2.0` in the k>=1 iterations, while arm-O3v used a different shape, which explains the config pattern. Removed; added #2.0/#-2.0/#-1.0/#4.0 cases for F32 and F64.
2. k_fminmax armv8: I had briefly changed VSEL to use FPSCR.NZCV in response to R1 F11. That is wrong: VSEL uses the APSR condition. The armv8 code does `vcmp; vmrs APSR_nzcv,fpscr; vcmp; vselgt; vmrs APSR_nzcv,fpscr; vselgt`, which only works with APSR-based VSEL. Reverted; F11 is refuted with that very kernel as evidence (20/20 with APSR, 1/20 with FPSCR).

Verification with the current tree, using a -O0 build of diffrun + the real loader, host reference compiled from the same kernel sources:
  arm-O2      k18_float + k_fminmax: 40/40 calls match (20 seeds each)
  thumb-O2    k18_float + k_fminmax: 40/40 calls match
  armv8-O3v   k18_float + k_fminmax: 40/40 calls match
Commands if you want to reproduce: build tests/emu/kernels into a lib with your cc_arm flags, then
  gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v17/run_tests.sh  (for V17 itself)
and diffrun --lib libkernels.so --lib libsupport.so --kernels <list with k18_float,k_fminmax> --seeds 0,1,2,...
My k_v17_fp.c is still waiting to be installed as tests/emu/kernels/k17_v17_fp.c (it is in my owned dir; please copy when convenient).
